# BTClock Rev A — Lolin S3 Mini: # Layout matches production partition.csv except app0/app1 are trimmed
# by 32 KiB so app1 starts on a clean 64 KiB (0x10000) MMU-page boundary
# and LittleFS is rounded up 1 KiB (411->412 KiB) so coredump starts on a
# 0x1000-aligned offset.
# The "storage" partition uses the `littlefs` subtype (vs `spiffs` in
# production). esp_littlefs matches on partition label either way
# rename is functionally inert at runtime; the subtype change just
# documents intent and lets `idf.py partition-table` show the right FS
# kind. Size is inherited from production (412 KiB) — scope asked for
# ~512 KiB on a 4 MB board but shrinking the app slots to free that up
# is out of scope for this task (would force a re-partition on any
# existing devices).
# Name
nvs
otadata
app0
app1
storage
coredump
# 0x3E7000..0x400000 (~100 KiB) intentionally unused — reserved for
